notes: Highest-paying Unity vertical in Poland. Huuuge Games (Szczecin/Warsaw), Ten Square Games (Wroclaw), Playtika Poland, SuperScale, Joyteractive, Reality Games. F2P mobile is where Unity C# skills command the biggest premium; live-ops and monetisation experience adds 10-20%

Online casino is restricted for Polish operators, but B2B suppliers and dev hubs are present (Playson, Relax Gaming, Betsson tech offices). Unity used for slot/casino client-side. Pays close to mobile F2P; fewer openings
Carbon Studio, Vive Studios PL, plus enterprise/industrial XR integrators. Unity is the default engine here. Steady but smaller hiring volume than games
Defence, medical and industrial training simulators. Unity-heavy but a small niche; few public salary bands, Head-level data unavailable
Poland's EdTech leaders (Brainly, Photon Entertainment) are mostly web/mobile-native rather than Unity. Gamified learning studios do hire Unity devs but pay ~15-25% below games. Limited sample
Unity porting/co-dev houses and general IT outsourcers serving EU/US clients. Lowest Unity rates in Poland; volume hiring at junior/mid
